groups.label: Solidbody Guitars
groups.heading: Solidbody Guitar Guides
groups.intro: I've gathered the Les Paul, SG and Firebird guides here. Choose the model on your guitar, then use that guide's year and condition references.
groups.overviewText: If you haven't identified the SG version, start with the family overview.

groups.label: ES And Archtops
groups.heading: ES And Archtop Guides
groups.intro: Choose the exact ES or archtop model before comparing years and configurations. Each guide explains its price ranges, condition and original parts.

groups.label: Acoustics
groups.heading: Acoustic Guitar Guides
groups.intro: Open the guide for your acoustic model, then check its covered years and repair notes. Include any known neck, bridge or body work when comparing your guitar.
groups.overviewText: For help choosing a model guide, I've also gathered the acoustic families in one overview.

faqs.q: Where Can I Find A Price Range For My Gibson?
faqs.a: Choose your model above, then find its year and configuration in the guide. I've kept the price tables and condition notes together on those model pages so you can read the assumptions with each comparison.

faqs.q: Which Guide Should I Use For An SG?
faqs.a: The Standard, Special, Junior and Custom each have a dedicated guide linked above. If you're unsure which SG you have, start with the SG family overview or send me photographs before choosing a comparison.
Yes. I've linked the J-45, J-200, Hummingbird and LG-series guides in the acoustic section. The Gibson acoustic overview connects those pages and explains the coverage for related models.

faqs.q: What If I Don't Know My Gibson's Model Or Year?
faqs.a: Send me clear photographs of the whole guitar, both sides of the headstock and its case, along with any history you know. You don't need to remove parts or open the electronics before getting in touch.
